note: wink-notes consumer app: engages the wink 0.2.0 verification contract with this build's own surfaces; checks with no counterpart here are exempted with a reason. The floating toast is a declared improvisation (case 05) and is intentionally left flagged, not suppressed.

ignore.wink/action-dark-variant: no warm-field context in this app (no dark CTA use case)
ignore.wink/destructive-not-focused: no destructive action in this app
ignore.wink/ledger-head: no table or ledger in this app
ignore.wink/progress-ring: uses the recorded progress track (pattern/progress), not a ring
ignore.wink/tick-marked: no tick / copy-with-mark surface in this app
ignore.wink/svg-census: no svg icons in this app
ignore.wink/review-tone: review item: copy register judged in the page review
ignore.wink/review-harmony: review item: single-page app, no multi-surface harmony claim
ignore.wink/review-typography-registers: review item: covered by the page review, not machine-checkable here
ignore.wink/review-hover-character: review item: hover character judged in the page review
